text:
Jamal R.: taking over night pass, I'm primary for next 8h (until 07:00 PST). Quick summary: AUTHZ-THROTTLE alert in us-west-2. Token store queue depth spiked ~11:22pm, pages fired 11:29pm. Pager INC-4492. I'll list what happened and what's live.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-4492 - authz-service throttle detected (us-west-2). alert: authz.throttle_rate_p95 > 120 for 5m. affected: auth requests (token-validate) - rate-limited responses increased.

Maria L.: seeing ~0.6% 502 rate for auth endpoints across a handful of tenants. CS flagged AcmeCorp (high concurrency) and Nimbus (batch jobs). No broad customer outage but degraded for high-concurrency flows.

Tia: actions taken: 1) scaled auth-workers from 6 -> 12 in prod-uswest2. 2) bumped token-store write QPS soft limit to 2000 for the next 30m. 3) enabled request-level backoff in proxy for non-critical clients. Monitoring queue depth and p99 latency.

Alex P.: scale command I ran:
```
kubectl -n prod-uswest2 scale deploy/auth-workers --replicas=12
```
Also flip to read-only validation fallback for tenants on the low-risk list (see runbook step 4). I enabled fallback for tenant IDs: acme-*, nimbus-*. That should reduce write pressure.

SRE Lead: checklist for night: - ensure autoscaler policy reverts after stabilization, - if error rate >1% for >10m escalate to on-call pager, - prep failover to eu-west if us-west saturates. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/authz-throttle

Maria L.: Customer comms: CS draft ready, will send targeted heads-up to AcmeCorp + Nimbus. Escalation channel opened and named contacts notified. No external status page update yet; waiting to see stability for 30m.

Tia: telemetry: queue depth peaked at 18k, now down to 7k after scaling. p95 latency improved from 480ms -> 130ms. still watching token-store error spikes.

Jamal R.: primary/secondary: I'm primary. Alex P. is secondary until 03:00 PST. Tia is monitoring logs. SRE Lead on-call for escalations.

oncall-bot: ALERT update: authz.throttle_rate_p95 down to 55 (below threshold) for 3m. Incident still open — watch for regression.

Alex P.: If we see regression, next steps per runbook: 1) increase replicas to 20, 2) toggle kv-cache aggressive expiry, 3) route low-risk tenants to read-only region (eu-west). I have permissions to do step 1 if needed.

Jamal R.: Handoff notes for incoming shift: - active incident INC-4492, currently stabilized but not resolved. - mitigations applied: scaled workers, read-only fallback, backoffs. - watch metrics: authz.throttle_rate_p95, token-store-queue-depth, 502-rate-by-tenant. - escalation threshold: 502-rate > 1% sustained for 10m or queue_depth > 12k.

Maria L.: CS will draft an external status if this impacts >5% of sessions. We're at ~0.6% so hold for now.

SRE Lead: add to morning agenda: root cause follow-up (token-store bottleneck), postmortem owner: Tia. Please collect 1h of detailed traces starting 11:15pm-11:45pm.

Jamal R.: leaving bridge notes here. if anyone picks up, ping me @jamal for handover. I'll check back in 30m then hand to morning follow: @Alex P. at 07:00 PST. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: NOTE: This thread will be kept for the incident timeline. Next automated check in 10m.
